content: {"rule": "K-S2", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"", "why": "The judge uses the single verse's qualified phrase as the reason to mark UNDERDETERMINED, which is a forbidden ground based on a single verse not stating the link or its contrary."}
